name: Estelle Ceulemans - Annexe, recommandation 12, point 1 - Am 9
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: 1. Employers should be able to address psychosocial risks within existing occupational safety and health structures or, where appropriate, through competent external services or persons, in accordance with national law and practice and taking into account the size and resources of the undertaking. Member States should avoid imposing requirements which result in disproportionate administrative or financial burdens, in particular for micro and small enterprises.
